name: Divfex Berhad
overview: 2026年，Divfex Berhad 的子公司 Excel Commerce Solutions Sdn Bhd 完成向 Prospek Teknik Sdn Bhd 和 Doyes Engineering Sdn Bhd 发行新股，募资 RM1.20 million，交易完成后 Excel 由 51.0% 持股子公司变为 48.11% 持股联营公司。公司另宣派两次中期单层股息，各 0.2 sen。
overview_en: In 2026, Divfex Berhad's subsidiary Excel Commerce Solutions Sdn Bhd completed a share subscription by Prospek Teknik Sdn Bhd and Doyes Engineering Sdn Bhd, raising RM1.20 million; following completion, Excel changed from a 51.0%-owned subsidiary to a 48.11%-owned associate company. The company also declared two interim single-tier dividends of 0.2 sen each.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 子公司 Excel Commerce Solutions Sdn Bhd 完成新股认购，公司持股由 51.0% 降至 48.11%，Excel 成为联营公司。
segments.note_en: Subsidiary Excel Commerce Solutions Sdn Bhd completed a share subscription, reducing the company's stake from 51.0% to 48.11%, and Excel became an associate company.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 认购于 2026 年 11 月 3 日完成，Excel 成为公司持股 48.11% 的联营公司。
actions.text_en: The subscription was completed on 3 November 2026, and Excel became a 48.11%-owned associate company of the company.

actions.title: CIRCULAR TO SHAREHOLDERS IN RELATION TO THE PROPOSED SHARE SUBSCRIPTION IN EXCEL COMMERCE SOLUTIONS SDN BHD (EXCEL), A 51.0%-OWNED SUBSIDIAR
actions.text: 公司向股东发出通函，说明上述 Excel 新股认购事项，认购价每股 RM20。
actions.text_en: The company issued a circular to shareholders regarding the proposed subscription of new shares in Excel at RM20 per subscription share.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Excel 与 Prospek Teknik Sdn Bhd 及 Doyes Engineering Sdn Bhd 签订股份认购协议，以 RM1.20 million 现金认购 60,000 股新股，占扩大后股本 5.66%。
actions.text_en: Excel entered into a share subscription agreement with Prospek Teknik Sdn Bhd and Doyes Engineering Sdn Bhd for the subscription of 60,000 new shares, representing 5.66% of the enlarged equity interest, for a cash subscription price of RM1.20 million.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: Excel Commerce Solutions Sdn Bhd 由 51.0% 持股子公司变为 48.11% 持股联营公司，不再纳入子公司合并范围。
model_changes.text_en: Excel Commerce Solutions Sdn Bhd changed from a 51.0%-owned subsidiary to a 48.11%-owned associate company and is no longer consolidated as a subsidiary.
